Players Committee card image of [[Commander Luke Skywalker (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Rogue 1, it is maneuver +2 and Luke draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During your control phase, may use 1 Force to take a speeder or a card with 'T-47' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
